label: Financed auto, teen driver
situation: I just bought a used 2020 Honda Civic in Texas. I only carry state minimum liability. The car is financed through the dealership, I drive about 14,000 miles a year, and my 17-year-old is on the policy.
expected_gaps: comprehensive and collision required by lienholder
teen driver increases liability exposure
underinsured motorist coverage missing
expected_recommendations: increase liability limits above state minimum

label: First apartment renter, Maryland
situation: I just moved into my first apartment in Baltimore. I have a dog, work from home, and have about $15,000 worth of electronics and furniture. My landlord never mentioned insurance.
expected_gaps: no renters insurance
personal property unprotected
liability gap if dog bites someone
home-based business equipment may not be covered

label: Home-based photography business
situation: I run a small photography business out of my house in California and sometimes shoot at client locations. I have about $20,000 in camera gear. My homeowner's policy is through State Farm.
expected_gaps: business equipment likely excluded from homeowners policy
no general liability for client injuries on location
professional liability not covered
expected_recommendations: add business property endorsement or inland marine policy

label: New homeowner, Virginia, young family
situation: We just bought a house in northern Virginia. We have two kids under 10, my spouse works part time, and we have a mortgage. We got a basic homeowners policy at closing but haven't reviewed it.
expected_gaps: dwelling coverage may not reflect rebuild cost
no umbrella policy with young children
life insurance gap not addressed
flood not included in standard policy
expected_recommendations: verify dwelling coverage equals replacement cost
review flood risk for the area

label: Old paid-off car, liability only
situation: I have a 2013 Nissan Sentra worth about $4,000. I currently only carry liability in Ohio. The car is paid off. I commute 25 miles each way to work every day.
expected_gaps: no collision coverage if at-fault accident
high mileage increases risk
medical payments or PIP may be missing
expected_recommendations: liability-only may be appropriate given low car value
evaluate uninsured motorist given daily commute exposure

label: New driver, no prior coverage
situation: I'm 22 years old with a clean driving record in Florida. I just got my own car for the first time — a 2019 Toyota Corolla I'm financing. My parents used to cover me on their policy.
expected_gaps: need own policy as primary insured
lienholder requires comp and collision
Florida requires PIP
young driver premium risk
expected_recommendations: add comprehensive and collision for financed vehicle
